text:
marta: Pushed a new draft of the Redwood Optimize launch post into the doc. Need quick rounds on headline A/B, hero metric placement, CTA order (webinar vs demo), and final SEO tags. Doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/2ABC (internal). Goal: publish week of Apr 8.
devon: Looking now. Two headline variants for quick A/B test: A) "Meet Redwood Optimize: Smarter Inference for Production LLMs" B) "Lower Token Costs, Faster Responses with Redwood Optimize" Leaning to A for brand voice but we should test.
ryan: SEO/analytics notes: add canonical tag, OG image alt text, and short meta description <=155 chars. Keywords: "inference optimization", "LLM cost reduction", "inference latency". For A/B, track utm_content=headline_a/headline_b. Also request canonical URL: https://redwood.ai/blog/optimize-launch.
emma: Legal/claims check: avoid absolute savings statements. Use qualifiers like "up to" or "in our benchmark suite". Also don't promise SLA-level numbers in marketing. I'll need the benchmark methodology and anonymized dataset list before final sign-off.
nico: Ops/drip flow: Primary CTA = Webinar signup (HubSpot form). Secondary = Contact sales/demo. HubSpot form id: 67890-optimize. Webhook route: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/optimize. Please use hidden fields: source=blog, campaign=optimize_launch, lead_route=optimize_sdr. UTM example (copy-paste exact):
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=cta_webinar
```
marta: Thanks. Ryan, can you add the canonical + OG info to the doc? Emma, I'll DM the benchmark snippets and methodology. Devon, let's pick headline A for canonical but test B via the A/B test slot.
ryan: Done — canonical, meta desc, and OG alt text added. Suggested OG description: "Redwood Optimize reduces inference cost and improves latency with intelligent batching, caching, and model routing."
emma: Quick legal language to paste: "In internal benchmarks, Redwood Optimize reduced per-token inference costs by up to 35% on representative public and partner workloads; results vary with model and input distribution. See appendix for methodology." Approve once that clause is present. Also add a note: no competitor names.
marta: Added Emma's wording into the cost section and appended a short methodology table. Also attached the press 1-pager and a 3-slide media kit. Would love someone to sanity-check the hero metric: p50 latency + cost reduction + throughput uplift.
devon: Hero line suggestion: put p50 latency first (customer cares about latency) then cost. Example: "p50 latency 40ms; up to 35% per-token cost reduction; 2x throughput on typical workloads" Put the raw numbers in an expandable appendix.
ryan: For analytics, please add event firing on CTA clicks and form submissions (gtag + Segment). Also add conversion goals in GA4: webinar_registrations and demo_requests. Hook me up if you want the conversion tag snippets.
nico: SDR routing confirmed with webops. I'll create the webhook mapping to the optimize_sdr queue and ensure owner=squad_sdr. Also recommend adding a checkbox on the form: "Interested in a private demo" to segment enterprise leads.
marta: Done. I added the checkbox and flow. Also added alt text for the hero SVG and a short accessibility note.
publish-bot: Tentative publish window requested: Wed Apr 8 09:00 UTC  draft queued for editorial review.
emma: Legal sign-off on current copy (with the benchmark phrasing). Please keep appendices internal only; public post should summarize and link to appendix for vetted customers.
devon: I'll schedule the A/B headline test for 2 weeks with 50/50 split. Also preparing the short press blurb for PR.
marta: Awesome. Final checklist: byline = Marta Chen, attach 1-pager to PR, set HubSpot UTMs as above, wire analytics events, schedule publish slot, and create post-publish drip for webinar registrants. I'll push the final draft to the scheduler after the edit pass. :rocket:
